Attention.title: Attention
Attention.body:
Pendenzen is the one place that shows what is waiting for a decision from you: the most urgent items first, then an index per area and the latest events.

Every row carries its decision: the two or three buttons its own page also offers, the reason it is waiting, and the sentence saying what the posting does. Only the hard case opens the page.

Areas you may not read do not appear at all. When nothing waits, the list says so plainly.
